statement.p: Consider the concentration, C, (in mg/liter) of a drug in the blood as a function of the amount of drug given, x, and the time since injection, t. For 0 \leq x \leq 4 mg and t \geq 0 hours, we have C = f(x,t) = 30te^{-\left(4-x\right)t}

Give a practical interpretation of your answer: f(2, 5) is
the concentration of a 5 mg dose in the blood 2 hours after injection.
the change in concentration of a 5 mg dose in the blood 2 hours after injection.
the change in concentration of a 2 mg dose in the blood 5 hours after injection.
the concentration of a 2 mg dose in the blood 5 hours after injection.
the amount of a 5 mg dose in the blood 2 hours after injection.
the amount of a 2 mg dose in the blood 5 hours after injection.
